title: Budget Agent Context by Module Blast Radius, Not File Count
summary: Rajat S. Lakhina models the context required to change a Swift module as its implementation, dependency interfaces, and dependent call sites. In a runnable 11-module sample, public type leakage makes the smallest module cost 5.08 times its own size; the absolute token verdict relies on stated assumptions, but the relative multiplier exposes architectural blast radius. A team can calibrate the model against one real cross-module change before using it in review.
takeaway: Map one shared module's implementation, imported interfaces, and dependent call sites; calibrate the model against a real change, then review any public type leak whose cost multiplier dominates its size.
